name: Your little story: Winter
source:
You were preparing for the New Year celebration, decorating the Christmas tree. But with your bad luck, you've slipped and fell and lost consciousness... When you came back to yourself, you found an incredibly beautiful person next to yourself. They claimed to be the spirit who came to your aid because all the toys for the Christmas tree were broken and there were only a few hours left before the New Year! Believe it or not? Smile or get angry? Agree or refuse? The choice is yours!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195350/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你正在准备庆祝新年，装饰圣诞树。但运气不好，你滑倒了，失去了知觉……回过神来，发现自己身边有一个美得不可思议的人。他们自称是来帮助你的精灵，因为圣诞树上的所有玩具都坏了，而且距离新年只剩下几个小时了！信不信？微笑还是生气？同意还是拒绝？选择权在你！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195350/]Steam[/url]]
